content.title: THE {{ORGANS}} NOBODY THINKS TO FEED UNTIL THEY FAIL
facts: **Follow along** - for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Your pancreas quietly runs your blood sugar behind the scenes, and broccoli sprouts are loaded with sulforaphane, a compound that helps calm inflammation around insulin-producing cells. Spinach adds magnesium, a mineral that's directly involved in how your body processes glucose, so a shortage can leave your pancreas working overtime. Your bladder gets a lot less love, but cranberries contain compounds that make it harder for bacteria to cling to the bladder wall in the first place, which is why they're linked to fewer recurring infections. And don't sleep on your thyroid - brazil nuts are one of the richest natural sources of selenium, a mineral your thyroid needs to convert its hormones into the active form your cells can actually use. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.

At @smarthealthfix we focus on nutrition, common health issues, the organs behind them, and the small daily habits that tie it all together. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
